source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The exact shared item, behavior, configuration, environment, time and used receiving concern stated in the member are established. The source contribution is actually connected to that concern with credible provenance, not merely imaginable tool use. A partial input can be material while other receiver premises remain open. Unknown correspondence is not an established false guard.
source_record.native_common_basis: Repeatable checks can expose consequential regressions at the levels they actually exercise. Automation is conditional on credible oracles, repeated use and economics; TDD is not universally required.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Charge design, execution, maintenance and flaky-check diagnosis; retain a targeted manual check, qualified analysis or no additional check where existing evidence is sufficient.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: Each member exact technical decision, configuration and actual authority; no universal process order or automatic exposure.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Conditional analytical partial-input relation. No empirical effect estimate, complete receiver entailment, legal applicability judgment, novelty or independent acceptance.

common_subconditions.P1: Actual common object and used receiving concern.
common_subconditions.P2: Complete native meanings support the specific input.
common_subconditions.P3: Literal input affects a receiving premise or its interpretation.
common_subconditions.P4: Missing premises, cost, cheaper alternative, nontrigger and stronger-claim counterexample remain explicit.

source_record.inference: The explicit contribution is material at its stated guard even when final action is confirmed rather than changed. Corresponding mechanisms may overlap; duplicate names, reused tests and common pipelines do not create additional benefit or independence.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: Identical test behavior treated as unique artifact identity.
A green pipeline treated as exposure authority.
An approved model treated as actual deployed state.
The same test counted as independent evidence twice.
All evidence discarded after harmless change.
All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.
A trace link treated as proof of the linked claim.

positive_controls.argument: The versioned two-sided contract supplies semantic oracles and compatibility boundaries for selecting and interpreting regression checks.
The anomaly record identifies the failure, affected versions and accepted residuals that the regression test must retain.
Model version, semantics and validation boundaries identify the correct test object and delimit what regression agreement means.
The pipeline supplies controlled execution, result provenance and receiving-decision linkage for justified regression evidence.

negative_controls.overclaim: Contract ownership cannot ensure that a test actually exercises the peer or covers all timing failures.
